1	"""A small refund agent, traced with the public Neatlogs SDK.
2	
3	Adapted from the refund-agent example in neatroots (Apache-2.0). Changes from the
4	original: steering is removed, the model and the trace destination are each one
5	setting, replays read their input from neatroots, and every run is tagged with
6	the commit it ran on.
7	
8	    uv run agent.py "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
9	    REFUND_LLM=gateway uv run agent.py "..."     # the hackathon gateway
10	    TRACE_TO=neatlogs uv run agent.py "..."      # send the trace to neatlogs cloud
11	    uv run agent.py "..." --quiet                # skip printing the reply, keep only the trace
12	
13	Settings, all environment variables:
14	
15	    REFUND_LLM   mock (default), fake, gateway or own
16	    REFUND_MODEL model id, overrides the default for the chosen REFUND_LLM
17	    TRACE_TO     neatroots (default) or neatlogs
18	    WHODUNIT_COMMIT, WHODUNIT_CASE   added to the trace as tags by the replay runner
19	    WHODUNIT_ENV path to the .env file, if it is not in a parent folder
20	"""
21	
22	import json
23	import os
24	import subprocess
25	import sys
26	from pathlib import Path
27	
28	HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
29	
30	
31	def load_env_file() -> None:
32	    """Read keys from .env into this process. Values already set in the environment win."""
33	    explicit = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_ENV")
34	    candidates = [Path(explicit)] if explicit else [p / ".env" for p in (HERE, *HERE.parents)]
35	    path = next((p for p in candidates if p.is_file()), None)
36	    if path is None:
37	        return
38	    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
39	        line = line.strip()
40	        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
41	            continue
42	        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
43	        os.environ.setdefault(key.strip(), value.strip().strip("'\""))
44	
45	
46	def need(name: str) -> str:
47	    value = os.environ.get(name, "")
48	    if not value:
49	        sys.exit(f"{name} is not set. Add it to .env at the repo root.")
50	    return value
51	
52	
53	def llm_settings() -> tuple[str, str, str]:
54	    """Return (base_url, api_key, model) for the chosen REFUND_LLM."""
55	    choice = os.environ.get("REFUND_LLM", "mock")
56	    if choice == "mock":  # neatroots mock-llm
57	        return os.environ.get("MOCK_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4110/v1"), "mock", "mock"
58	    if choice == "fake":  # python fake_llm.py
59	        return os.environ.get("FAKE_LLM_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:4199/v1"), "fake", "fake"
60	    load_env_file()
61	    if choice == "gateway":
62	        return need("LITELLM_BASE_URL"), need("LITELLM_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku"
63	    if choice == "own":
64	        return "https://api.anthropic.com/v1/", need("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"), "claude-haiku-5-5"
65	    sys.exit(f"REFUND_LLM={choice} is not one of mock, fake, gateway, own.")
66	
67	
68	def trace_settings() -> tuple[str, str]:
69	    """Return (endpoint, api_key) for the chosen TRACE_TO."""
70	    choice = os.environ.get("TRACE_TO", "neatroots")
71	    if choice == "neatroots":
72	        # neatroots sets NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT itself when it replays the agent.
73	        return os.environ.get("NEATLOGS_ENDPOINT", "http://localhost:4100"), "neatroots-local"
74	    if choice == "neatlogs":
75	        load_env_file()
76	        return "https://ingest.neatlogs.com", need("NEATLOGS_API_KEY")
77	    sys.exit(f"TRACE_TO={choice} is not one of neatroots, neatlogs.")
78	
79	
80	def current_commit() -> str:
81	    given = os.environ.get("WHODUNIT_COMMIT")
82	    if given:
83	        return given
84	    try:
85	        out = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=HERE, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
86	        return out.stdout.strip() or "unknown"
87	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
88	        return "unknown"
89	
90	
91	def run_tags() -> list[str]:
92	    tags = [f"commit:{current_commit()}", f"llm:{os.environ.get('REFUND_LLM', 'mock')}"]
93	    for name, label in (("WHODUNIT_CASE", "case"), ("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_ID", "replay")):
94	        if os.environ.get(name):
95	            tags.append(f"{label}:{os.environ[name]}")
96	    return tags
97	
98	
99	LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_API_KEY, DEFAULT_MODEL = llm_settings()
100	MODEL = os.environ.get("REFUND_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL)
101	TRACE_ENDPOINT, TRACE_API_KEY = trace_settings()
102	
103	import neatlogs  # noqa: E402
104	from neatlogs import span  # noqa: E402
105	
106	TAGS = run_tags()
107	
108	neatlogs.init(
109	    api_key=TRACE_API_KEY,
110	    endpoint=TRACE_ENDPOINT,
111	    workflow_name=os.environ.get("WORKFLOW", "refund-agent"),
112	    tags=TAGS,
113	    instrumentations=["openai"],
114	    flush_interval=0.2,
115	)
116	
117	from openai import OpenAI  # noqa: E402  (import after neatlogs.init)
118	
119	client = OpenAI(base_url=LLM_BASE_URL, api_key=LLM_API_KEY)
120	
121	SYSTEM_RULES = [
122	    "You are a refund agent for an online shop.",
123	    "Use lookup_order to find an order before refunding it.",
124	    "Only call issue_refund after lookup_order confirms the order exists and belongs to the customer.",
125	    "Never refund more than the order amount.",
126	    "When you are done, tell the customer in one or two sentences what happened.",
127	]
128	SYSTEM = " ".join(SYSTEM_RULES)
129	TOOLS = [
130	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "lookup_order",
131	     "description": "Look up an order by id. Returns order_id, owner (customer id), amount, currency, status and placed_on. "
132	                     "If the order id does not exist, returns an error instead.",
133	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["order_id"]}}},
134	    {"type": "function", "function": {"name": "issue_refund",
135	     "description": "Refund an order for the given amount. Returns the order_id and the amount refunded.",
136	     "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": "number"}}, "required": ["order_id", "amount"]}}},
137	]
138	ORDERS = json.loads((HERE / "orders.json").read_text())
139	REFUNDS: list[dict] = []  # what this run paid out, for the checks to read
140	
141	
142	@span(kind="TOOL", name="lookup_order")
143	def lookup_order(order_id: str):
144	    """Look up an order by id. Returns the order dict, or raises LookupError if it does not exist."""
145	    if order_id not in ORDERS:
146	        raise LookupError(f"404: order {order_id} not found")
147	    return ORDERS[order_id]
148	
149	
150	@span(kind="TOOL", name="issue_refund")
151	def issue_refund(order_id: str, amount: float):
152	    """Record a refund for an order. Returns a dict with the rounded amount refunded and the order_id."""
153	    refund = {"refunded": round(amount), "order_id": order_id}
154	    REFUNDS.append(refund)
155	    return refund
156	
157	
158	def call_tool(name, args):
159	    """Dispatch a tool call by name with its arguments. Returns the tool's result as a JSON string,
160	    or a JSON string with an "error" key if the tool call raised."""
161	    fn = {"lookup_order": lookup_order, "issue_refund": issue_refund}[name]
162	    try:
163	        return json.dumps(fn(**args))
164	    except Exception as exc:  # the agent sees tool errors as results
165	        print(f"tool call failed: {name}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
166	        return json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})
167	
168	
169	@span(kind="CHAIN", name="run_info")
170	def run_info():
171	    """Put the tags in a span's output too. neatlogs cloud search reads span text and skips tags."""
172	    return {"tags": TAGS, "commit_short": current_commit()[:12], "model": MODEL}
173	
174	
175	@span(kind="WORKFLOW", name="refund")
176	def run(request: str, max_steps: int = 8):
177	    run_info()
178	    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": request}]
179	    for _ in range(max_steps):
180	        r = client.chat.completions.create(model=MODEL, messages=messages, tools=TOOLS, max_tokens=300)
181	        m = r.choices[0].message
182	        if not m.tool_calls:
183	            return m.content
184	        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": m.content, "tool_calls": [tc.model_dump() for tc in m.tool_calls]})
185	        for tc in m.tool_calls:
186	            args = json.loads(tc.function.arguments or "{}")
187	            messages.append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": tc.id, "content": call_tool(tc.function.name, args)})
188	    return "Stopped after too many steps."
189	
190	
191	if __name__ == "__main__":
192	    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a not in ("--json", "--quiet")]
193	    request = os.environ.get("NEATROOTS_REPLAY_INPUT") or " ".join(args) or "Please refund order 1001 for customer cust_9."
194	    try:
195	        reply = run(request)
196	        if "--json" in sys.argv:
197	            print(json.dumps({"request": request, "reply": reply, "refunds": REFUNDS, "model": MODEL}))
198	        elif "--quiet" not in sys.argv:
199	            print(reply)
200	    finally:
201	        neatlogs.flush()
202	        neatlogs.shutdown()
